title: Improve worker RabbitMQ reconnect and heartbeat behavior
reason: PRB-1001 links repeated worker consumer exits after broker connection interruptions.
risk: Medium: worker connection behavior changes can affect message consumption; synchronous API path is not directly modified.
implementation_plan: implement bounded reconnect behavior and explicit heartbeat settings
exercise a broker interruption while processing synthetic tickets
promote only if consumer reconnects and processing recovers without manual restart
validation_plan: worker consumer count returns to one after controlled interruption
queue depth drains without manual worker restart
worker failure counter does not increase unexpectedly
synthetic customer journey returns to success
request and event correlation remains available
rollback_plan: redeploy the recorded last-good worker release
run the production customer-path verification gate
